hpe_svg_paint.brief: 绘制 `<svg>` 子树 / Paint the `<svg>` subtree

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.y_dev: in:盒子顶边的设备 y / Device y of the box's top edge

hpe_svg_paint.note: 内容直接来自 DOM，不经过盒子树 / The content is painted straight from the DOM rather than from boxes

hpe_svg_hit_test.brief: 对 `<svg>` 子树做命中测试 / Hit test an `<svg>` subtree

params.x: in:文档坐标 X / Document-space X
params.y: in:文档坐标 Y / Document-space Y

hpe_svg_hit_test.return: 最深的包含该点的 SVG 元素（`<rect>` 上的点击会冒泡到其 `<g>`），未命中返回 `NULL` / The deepest SVG element containing the point (a click on a `<rect>` bubbles up to its `<g>`), or `NULL`
hpe_svg_hit_test.note: 路径目前尚未参与命中测试 / Paths are not hit tested yet
